summary: No change: submission.json again contains only a rationale and adds no sources, investigations, knowledge, gaps, interpretations or experiment; the bytes validate with no diagnostics. The run's record is complete for this session - all questions explained with a retained receipt or an explicit source-only basis, no necessary gap open, no execution without an interpretation, and findings with counterevidence plus sourced Behaviour entries on the record. With the budget expiring in this turn, a new experiment could not receive the interpretation that makes it evidence and further sourced entries would restate recorded code; expiry preserves the retained work and needs no closing call, leaving defect validity, CFT relevance and deduplication to human offline review.
